arrive.text: A waiting room. You and Jones have both applied for the same job.

told.text: The president has told you himself: Jones will get the job.

counted.text: And you've just watched Jones count the coins in his pocket. Ten.

window.text: Round green hills, in tidy rows, all the way to the sky.

concluded.text: So. The man who gets the job has ten coins in his pocket.

waited.text: You don't draw any conclusions. You just wait your turn.

twist.text: You got the job. Not Jones.

yours.text: And in your own pocket: ten coins. You never counted them.

end.text: You believed it. It was true. You had good reason. But it was true of the wrong man. Did you know it?

yours_2.text: Ten coins in your own pocket. You never counted them.

end_2.text: It's true, now, that the man who got the job has ten coins in his pocket. You just never believed it.
